cards.text: Just before this, Solomon's heart turned after other gods, and the LORD told him He would tear the kingdom away from him (1 Kings 11:4, 11). Now trouble starts showing up, and the first name on the list is Hadad the Edomite, from the royal line of Edom.

cards.question: It's the LORD who raised up Hadad the Edomite as an adversary against Solomon.

cards.text: Earlier, when David was in Edom, Joab, the commander of the army, had gone to bury the dead and had struck down every male in Edom. Joab and all Israel stayed there six months, until he had killed every male in Edom.

cards.question: Joab struck down every male in Edom. So how is Hadad the Edomite still alive to be Solomon's adversary?

answers.text: He fled the country as a young boy
Joab spared him as a royal prisoner
He was away on a trip to Tyre

cards.question: Where does young Hadad flee with his father's servants?
Hadad and his men go from Midian to Paran, take men from Paran with them, and reach Pharaoh king of Egypt. What does Pharaoh give Hadad?

answers.text: A house and land and food
A post in his royal army
A ship to sail back home

cards.text: Friend, in all my years stuck in the back of a junk drawer, the best spot I ever got was under a takeout menu, and Hadad gets a HOUSE. Then Hadad finds such great favor with Pharaoh that Pharaoh gives him a wife: the sister of Queen Tahpenes, Pharaoh's own wife.
Hadad and his wife have a son named Genubath, and Queen Tahpenes herself weans him.

cards.question: Hadad's son Genubath lives in Pharaoh's palace among the sons of Pharaoh.
In Egypt, Hadad hears that David has rested with his fathers and that Joab is dead. What does Hadad ask Pharaoh?

answers.text: To let him return to his own country
To give him soldiers to fight Israel
To let Genubath rule over Edom

cards.text: I bet Pharaoh's jaw drops. He asks, "What have you lacked here with me that you suddenly want to go back to your own country?"

cards.question: Pharaoh asks Hadad what he has lacked in Egypt. How does Hadad answer?

answers.text: He lacked nothing but still wants to go
He misses his father's people in Edom
He fears Pharaoh will turn against him

cards.text: That's like quitting the best job you ever had, and when the boss asks what's wrong, you just say, 'Nothing.' And Hadad isn't the only one, because God raises up another adversary against Solomon.

cards.question: The new adversary is Rezon son of Eliada, who had fled from his ___, Hadadezer king of Zobah.

cards.text: Rezon gathers men to himself. When David killed the Zobaites, Rezon captained a band of raiders.

cards.question: Rezon's band of raiders goes to ___, where they settle and gain control.
Rezon makes peace with Israel during Solomon's days.

cards.text: Rezon rules over Aram with hostility toward Israel, adding to the trouble caused by Hadad. Trouble is stacking up for Solomon like bills on a kitchen counter.
Now meet the third name, and this one comes from inside Israel. Jeroboam son of Nebat, an Ephraimite from Zeredah, whose mother is a widow named Zeruah.

cards.question: Jeroboam is one of Solomon's own servants.

cards.text: And this servant rebels against the king, which is WILD, because if one of my oven mitts ever rebelled against me, I'd lose. Here's the account: Solomon had built the supporting terraces and repaired the gap in the wall of the city of his father David.

cards.question: Solomon notices that Jeroboam, a mighty man of valor, is an industrious young man. What does Solomon do with him?

answers.text: Puts him over the labor force of Joseph's house
Makes him commander of the whole army
Sends him to rebuild the walls of Gezer

cards.text: Then the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite meets Jeroboam on the road out of Jerusalem, wrapped in a new cloak. Just the two of them, alone in the open field, like your boss saying 'walk with me' and you have NO idea which way this is going.

cards.question: Alone in the field, what does Ahijah do with his new cloak?

answers.text: Spreads it out on the road

cards.text: He tore up a brand NEW cloak, friend, not the old one, the NEW one! Then Ahijah tells Jeroboam, "Take ten pieces for yourself," because this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says.

cards.question: Ten pieces of cloak for Jeroboam, because the LORD says He will give him ten ___.
The LORD says one tribe will remain. Why?

answers.text: For the sake of David and Jerusalem
Because Solomon will turn back to Him
Because Jeroboam will ask for mercy

cards.question: Then the LORD says why the kingdom is being torn. What reason does He give?

answers.text: Forsaking Him to worship other gods

cards.text: The LORD names the gods: Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites and Milcom the god of the Ammonites. And He says the ones who forsook Him have not walked in His ways or kept His statutes and judgments, as Solomon's father David did.

cards.question: The LORD won't take the whole kingdom out of Solomon's hand. How long will Solomon stay ruler?

answers.text: All the days of his life

cards.text: That's for the sake of David, whom the LORD chose because he kept His commandments and statutes.

cards.question: The ten tribes will be taken from the hand of Solomon's ___ and given to Jeroboam.

cards.text: Ten tribes to Jeroboam, ONE to Solomon's son, which is like baking a whole tray and getting handed back one cookie. But that one tribe is so David will always have a lamp before the LORD in Jerusalem, the city where He chose to put His Name.
Ahijah is still out in that field with Jeroboam, passing along what the LORD says. Now the LORD's words turn to Jeroboam himself.

cards.question: What does the LORD promise Jeroboam?

answers.text: He will be king over Israel
He will be a prophet like Ahijah
He will be governor over Ephraim

cards.text: But there's an IF. If Jeroboam listens to all the LORD commands, walks in His ways and does what is right as David did, then the LORD will be with him.

cards.question: If Jeroboam obeys, the LORD will build him a lasting ___ just as He built for David.
The LORD says He will humble David's descendants forever.

cards.text: Humbled, but not forever. So Solomon seeks to kill Jeroboam.

cards.question: Solomon seeks to kill Jeroboam. What does Jeroboam do?

answers.text: He flees to Shishak king of Egypt
He hides in the hill country of Ephraim
He raises an army against Solomon

cards.text: Jeroboam lands with Shishak, king of Egypt. Same country young Hadad ran to, so Egypt is starting to look like a waiting room.

cards.question: How long does Jeroboam stay in Egypt with Shishak?

cards.text: As for the rest of what Solomon did, and his wisdom, it's all written in the Book of the Acts of Solomon. He reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel for forty years.

cards.question: Solomon rests with his fathers and is buried in the city of his father David. Who reigns in his place?

cards.text: Hang onto your apron, friend. This kingdom story is NOT done yet.
